product.title: Private Sailing Charter on San Diego Bay

description.text: Set out on a private San Diego Bay sail crafted for your group only, with a captain handling navigation while you enjoy skyline views and harbor landmarks from the water. This charter is ideal for celebrations, date nights, and small-group outings that want a more premium, uncrowded format. You can follow a captain-recommended route or tailor the pace and atmosphere to your occasion.

highlights: Private yacht charter reserved for your party.
Bay and skyline views with a flexible route format.
Great fit for birthdays, small celebrations, and premium group outings.
Captain-led experience with optional customization on the water.

start.description: Viche Marina Deli, 1880 Harbor Island Dr, San Diego, CA 92101, USA. Meet around 10 minutes before departure.

itineraryItems.title: San Diego Bay
itineraryItems.description: Cruise through the bay with views of the downtown waterfront and Coronado-area landmarks.

itineraryItems.title: Harbor Highlights
itineraryItems.description: Typical pass-by points can include USS Midway, Coronado Bridge, and Point Loma areas.

faqs.question: Is this a private charter or a shared sail?
faqs.answer: This listing is for a private charter, so only your booked group is on board.

faqs.question: How many guests can join this sailing trip?
faqs.answer: Group size is small and typically capped at six guests per booking, depending on the operator rules.

faqs.question: What is included with the charter?
faqs.answer: A captain, private sailing time, and light refreshments such as water and snacks are generally included.

faqs.question: What happens if weather is not ideal?
faqs.answer: The captain monitors marine conditions and can adjust routes or timing; severe conditions may require rescheduling for safety.

faqs.question: Can we bring our own food or drinks?
faqs.answer: Basic snacks and drinks are commonly provided, and bring-your-own options may be allowed based on operator policy.
